records.title: MixCompress: Mixture of Experts for Variable Rate Learned Image Compression
records.reason: MixCompress is a learned image-compression model; MoE is used for rate-distortion coding rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Policy-Conditioned Constrained Decoding for Column-Level Access Control in Text-to-SQL
records.reason: PCC-SQL improves deterministic policy enforcement but spends up to 10% more tokens and does not claim speed or compute savings.

records.title: Aletheia: An Offline-First Clinical Decision Support System for Differential Diagnosis in Low-Resource Healthcare Settings
records.reason: Aletheia fits QLoRA inference within a low-resource memory budget, but its ten-case evaluation is small and lacks baseline latency/throughput.
